paragraphs.source_en: Our salesperson realizes from her qualifying question that this person does not have the power to make a purchasing decision at this time. Furthermore, he probably does not have all that much insight into the day-to-day operations at the hospital. She decides that she should not spend her time with these midlevel administrators because they have been intimidated into cutting their spending.
